value.rationale: Natural interaction of two independently measurable arithmetic invariants of genus-three curves: rational Jacobian two-torsion and rational canonical bitangents. The joint table yields sharp abstract rank-conditioned existence thresholds and exact possible count restrictions, not merely the standard 28-bitangent or symplectic group counts.
